changes.to: Zen's own Prahasta page (checked 2026-11-17) describes the robot and its weapon compatibility but publishes no numeric specification at all - no mass, dimensions, speed, payload, runtime or battery. Press coverage of the July 2024 launch gives 2.5 h with a 45 kg load, an 80 kg lift and obstacles of about 40 cm, but those figures are press-only, so no field is filled.
Zen Technologies' four-legged robot for counter-insurgency and close-quarter defence work, using LiDAR and reinforcement learning and carrying 9 mm, 5.56 mm or 7.62 mm small arms.
